ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, filled pill buttons, navigation emphasis, logo wordmark — the only dark anchor in an otherwise white system

paper.$description: Paper — Page canvas, card surfaces, product preview background — the default ground for all content

graphite-hairline.$description: Graphite Hairline — All structural borders, dividers, card edges, input borders — the most-used color in the system by frequency, defining every container

vellum.$description: Vellum — Secondary surface fills, subtle hover washes, tertiary panel background — the lightest gray still distinct from white

slate.$description: Slate — Secondary body text, metadata, icon strokes, tab labels — the primary muted text voice

pewter.$description: Pewter — Helper text, descriptive captions, micro-copy — darker than Slate for emphasized secondary text

ash.$description: Ash — Tertiary text, disabled link color, placeholder text — the quietest readable gray

carbon.$description: Carbon — SVG fill and stroke for icons, 3D graphic elements — nearly identical to Ink but reserved for decorative vector work

stone.$description: Stone — Decorative fills, gradient endpoints, subtle background washes — never used for text or borders

cream-notice.$description: Cream Notice — Announcement bar background, the single warm accent in the entire system — used only for the top promotional strip

monument-grotesk.$description: The sole typeface for everything from 12px captions to 72px display headlines. No bold, no italic, no light — a single weight does all expressive work. The dramatic size jump from 18px subheading directly to 36px heading creates a distinctive editorial scale where display type towers over body text. Tight line-heights at display sizes (1.00–1.11) let large type stack into near-solid blocks.
